intent: Test whether NEPA graph gates improve EA review quality without hardcoding the final case mix, metric set, or success thresholds into the evaluator.
stop_condition: Stop and record a blocked or null result if support for the hypothesis would require post-hoc threshold tuning, runtime compliance/phase-eval graph-gate adoption, new applicability or legal conclusions, hidden case-family heuristics, or production source_library mutation.

hypothesis.h1: Graph-gated review produces measurably higher quality review outputs than the same review path without graph-gate evidence.
hypothesis.h0: Graph-gated review does not produce a measurable review-quality improvement over the same review path without graph-gate evidence.
